title: Peace in Christ
definition: Peace in Christ is the believer's inward and relational calm grounded in reconciliation with God and trust in Jesus.
summary: Peace in Christ is the believer's inward rest and steadiness that flows from belonging to the risen Lord.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Prince of Peace who reconciles sinners to God and guards His people's hearts.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Peace in Christ is the settled rest believers have through reconciliation with God and the guarding presence of Christ. Scripture speaks of peace as both a status before God and a comfort in trouble.

This peace is not the absence of hard circumstances or difficult emotions. It is the presence of Christ and the assurance that the believer is held by Him.

Jesus gives peace that the world cannot give. His cross makes peace with God, and His presence sustains the heart.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because anxiety, conflict, guilt, and suffering can make believers feel abandoned or unsafe. Peace in Christ teaches that the deepest security of the soul is not circumstances but the Savior Himself.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring anxious thoughts to Christ in prayer and return to the promises of God. Pursue peace with others where possible, and remind your heart that Christ's peace is stronger than the moment you are facing.
